== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100701 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100701], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100701-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>717f96976c838a91cec9b7e1b41d282cf715ee8dea0efffe723c79ad72ba4d7b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
